title: Market Research Operations
purpose: Standard procedure for conducting market research, selecting analysis methods, logging stock picks, tracking performance, and maintaining the picks index. Ensures consistent, auditable market research across all teams.

method_selection.title: Selecting Analysis Methods
method_selection.overview: Analysis methods are stored in market-research/methods/. Each method defines a systematic approach to evaluating stocks or market conditions.

steps.purpose: See all available analysis approaches before starting research

steps.action: Read the method file to understand its criteria, inputs, and scoring system
Select the method that best matches your research objective

guidelines.fundamental_analysis: For long-term value investing, earnings-based decisions
guidelines.technical_analysis: For pattern-based, momentum, or timing decisions
guidelines.quantitative_screening: For filtering large universes down to candidates
guidelines.hybrid_methods: For combining multiple approaches (recommended for comprehensive analysis)

steps.action: Document which method you selected and why in your team output

research_workflow.title: Conducting Research
research_workflow.overview: Follow a structured workflow from data gathering through analysis to pick generation.

steps.action: Gather data using SOP-017 (Data Gathering Operations)
steps.note: Use hybrid method for quality when making investment-grade research

steps.action: Apply the selected analysis method's scoring criteria to gathered data
steps.output: A scored list of candidates with rationale for each score

steps.action: Rank candidates by composite score and identify top picks
steps.threshold: Only picks scoring in the top 20% of the analysis should be logged

steps.action: Write a brief thesis for each pick: why it was selected, key catalysts, risk factors
Cross-validate picks against at least one alternative method or data source

logging_picks.title: Logging Picks with TEMPLATE.md
logging_picks.overview: Every pick must be formally logged using the standard template for auditability and performance tracking.

steps.action: Copy the template for your new pick
Fill in all required fields in the template
required_fields: Entry price (current price at time of pick)
Thesis (2-5 sentences on why this pick was made)

steps.action: Verify all fields are populated. Incomplete picks must not be submitted.
steps.validation: Every required field must have a non-empty value

tracking_performance.title: Performance Tracking
tracking_performance.overview: Track pick performance over time to evaluate method effectiveness and improve future research.

steps.action: Update pick status at defined checkpoints: 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, or when target/stop-loss is hit
When a pick is closed (target hit, stop-loss hit, or time expired), calculate final return
Record lessons learned: what the method got right, what it missed, what to improve

updating_index.title: Updating picks/index.json
updating_index.overview: The picks index is the central registry of all picks. It must be updated whenever a pick is created or its status changes.

steps.action: Add a new entry for each new pick with these fields
When updating an existing pick, modify only the changed fields (status, current_price, return_pct, notes)
Validate the JSON is well-formed after editing

before_research: Select and document the analysis method
Verify data gathering tools are working (SOP-017)
Check existing picks to avoid duplicate research
during_research: Write thesis for each pick candidate
after_research: Log each pick using TEMPLATE.md with all required fields
Record method used and team in pick file
Set calendar reminders for performance check dates
